title: B-Roll: Alaska Air National Guard deploys in support of hurricane disaster relief
description: Two HH-60 Pave Hawk helicopters from the California Air National Guardʼs 129th Rescue Wing are loaded onto a C-17 Globemaster III crewed by members of the Alaska Air National Guardʼs 249th Airlift Squadron from Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Alaska, at Moffett Federal Airfield, Calif., Aug. 28, 2017. The helicopters and their crew members, along with personnel from the AKANGʼs 212th Rescue Squadron are being transported to Fort Hood, Texas, to assist with hurricane Harvey response efforts. The Guardsmen will be tasked with missions to support the Texas National Guard and the state of Texas with search and rescue efforts in the aftermath of Hurricane Harvey and as ongoing storm conditions continue to inflict damage.
keywords: response, disaster relief operations, alaska national guard, Hurricane Harvey
